text:
elena (PM): quick sync 1: planning the EU-first latency-priority rollout. aim: prioritize low-latency tenants in eu-region without increasing cost or hurting quality. wants conservative safety gates + customer opt-ins.

ravi (eng): proposal sketch: new flag `adaptive_region_priority` with variants `baseline`, `latency_pref_v1`. routing will add header `X-Route-Mode`. Flag supports region and tenant_tag targeting.

noah (sre): constraints: eu capacity tight during peak. fallback rules must be deterministic: first try local soft-fallback (quantized model), then remote fallback (route to control region), then default control. Add circuit-breaker: if p99 latency > 1s or error rate +5ppt vs baseline -> initiate soft-fallback.

tess (prod-ops): rollout sequnce: (A) smoke on staging internal 1h; (B) internal canary 2% internal traffic 24h; (C) EU pilot customers (opt-in) 0.5% for 72h; (D) gradual ramp 15 over 5 days. run A/B pair for quality continuously.

meera (data): define evaluation plan: seed prompts + stratified sample of 10k recent EU queries. metrics: semantic-similarity delta (embedding cosine), hallucination tag rate, and conversion proxy. gates: similarity >= 0.98 of baseline AND hallucination_rate <= 1.5x baseline. will publish seed file ref: `/evals/adaptive_region/seed_v2`.

elena (PM): telemetry gates list: latency p50/p95/p99 by tenant_tier, regional cost per 1k tokens, fallback_ratio, quality flags. thresholds: p50 <= 1.1x, p95 <= 1.25x, cost change < 4%.

ravi (eng): rollout infra: flag API will accept `region`, `tenant_ids[]`, `percent`. Example: `POST /flags/rollout {"flag":"adaptive_region_priority","cohort":"eu_pilot","variant":"latency_pref_v1","pct":0.5}`. Also will emit `X-Route-Mode` and `X-Routing-Fallback`.

noah (sre): add automated short-circuit: if fallback_ratio > 0.1 for first 30m OR sustained p95 breach -> auto-disable flag and page oncall. Soft-disable first (stop new assignments) then hard-disable if infra still unhealthy.

tess (prod-ops): kill-switch ownership: ops owns immediate toggles, eng + pm in cc. limit toggles: max 3 manual toggles per 10m, require reason in audit log.

shipbot: scheduled run queued: `start-canary --flag adaptive_region_priority --cohort eu_internal --pct 2 --duration 24h --notify #canary-eu-6159876543`

meera (data): A/B logging: capture `response_embedding`, `top_k_confidence`, `latency_ms`, `variant_tag`. store anonymized logs to `ab/adaptive_region/v2/` with 30d retention for canary. privacy team signoff needed before external pilot.

elena (PM): customer coordination: Pilot customer "Northwind" signed up for EU pilot. tess to confirm contract opt-in and support window.

tess (prod-ops): will add Northwind to pilot cohort and circulate support runbook. runbook checklist: rollback steps, how-to trigger soft/hard fallback, contact list.

ravi (eng): dev TODOs: - implement header tracing - add per-tenant override - ensure logging retention policy - add rollout dry-run mode for checks

noah (sre): monitoring TODOs: synthetic queries targeting latency-sensitive endpoints, dashboard per-tenant, alert: >5% requests hitting fallback in 15m -> page, staging smoke test prior to canary start.

meera (data): will provide baseline numbers and quality check template by EOD. will run an initial offline sim to estimate expected fallback_ratio.

elena (PM): launch criteria summary: 24h staging smoke green, internal canary stable (no auto-kill) for 24h, pilot customer satisfied, all telemetry gates within thresholds for 72h pilot. any gate fail -> abort ramp and revert.

tess (prod-ops): timeline: staging smoke tomorrow 08:00 UTC, internal canary tomorrow 12:00 UTC. Northwind pilot earliest after internal green.

ravi (eng): I'll land the flag + routing changes today. will post a short PR link in shiproom when ready.

shipbot: canary started for cohort eu_internal. updates posted to #canary-eu-6159876543.

noah (sre): proposal: automatic rollback if p99 > 1s for >5m OR fallback_ratio > 10% for >30m. fine?

elena (PM): agree. add to rollout policy doc and shiproom checklist.

(ends)
